patient_notes: Take with food (reduces orthostatic effects)
Missed dose: take when remembered unless time for next; don't double

drugs.nda_holder: NDA018716 Trandate tablet – current holder Alvogen (Disc.); NDA018687 Normodyne tablet – Schering (Disc.)
drugs.boxed_warning: No
common_ar: Controlled trials (labetalol vs placebo): dizziness 11%, fatigue, nausea, dyspepsia 3%, nasal stuffiness 3%, ejaculation failure 2%; transient scalp tingling at start
warnings: Hepatic injury (rare, can be fatal) – check LFTs at first symptoms
interactions: Nitroglycerin: blunts reflex tachycardia, additive hypotension
patient_notes: Bioavailability increased with food (label PK)
uncertain: Generic label (ANDA074787).

drugs.nda_holder: NDA021742 Bystolic – current holder Allergan (Drugs@FDA)
drugs.boxed_warning: No
common_ar: Most common: headache, fatigue
warnings: Do not stop abruptly; taper 1–2 weeks
patient_notes: With or without food
Missed dose: take next scheduled dose only (professional label) / or when remembered unless near next (patient info); don't double

drugs.nda_holder: NDA018553 Inderal LA & NDA021438 InnoPran XL – ANI Pharms; NDA016418 Inderal tablet (Wyeth) Discontinued

warnings: Abrupt discontinuation → angina/MI; taper over weeks

drugs.nda_holder: NDA019668 Cardura & NDA021269 Cardura XL – Viatris
drugs.boxed_warning: No
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to doxazosin or other quinazolines (prazosin, terazosin)
common_ar: Most common: fatigue, malaise, hypotension, dizziness
warnings: Postural hypotension/syncope esp. first dose or dose increase
patient_notes: Food effect not clinically significant (label PK)
uncertain: Label read is Greenstone/Viatris-distributed SPL under NDA019668.

drugs.nda_holder: NDA019057/NDA020347 Hytrin – Abbott; Discontinued
drugs.boxed_warning: No
common_ar: BPH (significantly > placebo): asthenia, postural hypotension, dizziness, somnolence, nasal congestion/rhinitis, impotence
warnings: Syncope & first-dose effect – start 1 mg at bedtime; recurs if interrupted several days
interactions: Other antihypertensives, especially verapamil: significant hypotension – reduce dose
patient_notes: First dose 1 mg at bedtime
uncertain: Generic label (ANDA075317).

drugs.nda_holder: NDA017442 Minipress – Pfizer
drugs.boxed_warning: No
contraindications: Known sensitivity to quinazolines, prazosin or inert ingredients
common_ar: Dizziness 10.3%, headache 7.8%, drowsiness 7.6%, lack of energy 6.9%, weakness 6.5%, palpitations 5.3%, nausea 4.9%
warnings: Syncope with sudden loss of consciousness, usually 30–90 min after first dose (~1% at ≥2 mg); start 1 mg
interactions: Diuretics/other antihypertensives: additive hypotension – reduce prazosin to 1–2 mg TID and retitrate
PDE-5 inhibitors: additive hypotension – start PDE-5 at lowest dose
uncertain: Label read is a repackager SPL under NDA017442.

drugs.nda_holder: NDA017407 Catapres tablet – Boehringer Ingelheim (Disc.); NDA018891 Catapres-TTS – current holder Lavipharm
drugs.boxed_warning: No for oral tablets (only epidural Duraclon has a boxed warning)
common_ar: Dose-related: dry mouth ~40/100, drowsiness ~33/100, dizziness ~16/100, constipation and sedation ~10/100 each
warnings: Withdrawal: sudden stop → nervousness, agitation, headache, tremor, rapid BP rise (rarely encephalopathy, stroke, death); taper over 2–4 days
Worse with high dose or concurrent beta-blocker
interactions: Digitalis, CCBs, beta-blockers: bradycardia/AV block; with diltiazem/verapamil severe bradycardia
patient_notes: Do not stop without doctor
Larger dose at bedtime reduces dry mouth/drowsiness
Caution driving; dry eyes with contact lenses
uncertain: Generic tablet label (ANDA091368).

drugs.nda_holder: NDA013400 Aldomet tablet – Merck; Discontinued

contraindications: Active hepatic disease (acute hepatitis, active cirrhosis)
common_ar: Sedation (early/after dose increase), headache, asthenia/weakness; no % given
warnings: Positive Coombs test (10–20% with prolonged use), hemolytic anemia
Edema/weight gain; stop if heart failure signs
interactions: Anesthetics: lower doses may be needed
uncertain: Generic label (Rising ANDA070076).

Edema/salt-water retention 7% (in non-edematous)
Pericarditis/effusion/tamponade
ECG T-wave changes
warnings: Salt/water retention & CHF – adequate (usually loop) diuretic required

drugs.nda_holder: NDA021985 Tekturna – current holder LXO Ireland (Drugs@FDA); pellet NDA210709 Discontinued
drugs.boxed_warning: Yes – FETAL TOXICITY: discontinue as soon as pregnancy detected; RAS drugs can injure/kill the fetus.
contraindications: With ARBs or ACEIs in diabetes
common_ar: Most common: diarrhea (2.3%)
interactions: Furosemide: aliskiren reduces furosemide exposure – monitor
Potassium supplements/K salt substitutes: advise patients not to use
patient_notes: Keep a routine pattern relative to meals; high-fat meals substantially decrease absorption

US indication: add-on for hypertension not controlled on other drugs
